property_summary: For every input _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract stores MinSum equal to the provided value _val; the mutant negates the assigned value (MinSum = ~_val) so for many _val the stored MinSum differs — the test asserts that c.MinSum() == _val after the call, which holds for reference but is violated by the mutant for some fuzzed _val.
change_summary: Negate assigned value by setting MinSum to the bitwise complement of the input, changing stored MinSum after the call.
